instrument: Satoshium Attestor Production Readiness Gate Preparation
gate_question: Is Attestor sufficiently implemented, internally consistent, validated, and operationally controlled to create its first real canonical Attestation and Trust Statement?
principles: Preparation is not the Gate decision.
Representative proof is not production proof.
No production ATT/TRST identifier is allocated during Gate Preparation.
A Gate item may be ready only when its required evidence artifact exists or the control is demonstrably executable before production identity allocation.

items.control: Canonical ATT/TRST schemas and executable validation rules are established.
basis: Representative ATT and TRST both reached VALID

items.control: Machine-testable validation and governed Review are explicitly separated.
Conformance mechanics are executable without collapsing Validation into Conformance.
basis: VALID + missing Review -> UNDETERMINED; VALID + satisfied Review -> CONFORMANT

items.control: Representative artifacts are barred from promotion/relabeling as production proof.
Production identifier allocation is controlled and occurs only after Gate PASS and operation start.
items.remaining_action: At Gate, affirm allocation procedure and that ATT-2026-0001 / TRST-2026-0001 remain unallocated.

items.control: A real governed matter can be selected and bounded without pre-allocating ATT/TRST identity.
items.remaining_action: Select the actual governed matter only after Gate PASS or as a non-allocating gate candidate, preserving source authority.

items.control: Production Eligibility can be recorded separately from Validation and Evaluation.
items.remaining_action: Create a production Eligibility Record template/contract before Gate evaluation.

items.control: Evaluation Basis can be recorded separately and traced to eligible governed inputs.
items.remaining_action: Create an Evaluation Basis template/contract before Gate evaluation.

items.control: Rule-constrained Evaluation can be preserved as a governed record distinct from the resulting TRST.
items.remaining_action: Create an Evaluation Record template/contract before Gate evaluation.

items.control: Source state at evaluation can be preserved in production evidence.
items.remaining_action: At production, bind the actual source-state evidence; Gate verifies the mechanism exists.

items.control: Production execution-context assertions require attributable evidence rather than bare booleans.
basis: Step 15 identified this production hardening requirement
items.remaining_action: Create production execution-context evidence contract linking each asserted fact to evidence references.

items.control: Lifecycle events can be recorded distinctly from object content.
items.remaining_action: Create a Lifecycle Event Record template/contract before Gate evaluation.

items.control: Publication remains a separate authorized decision.
items.remaining_action: Create a Publication Decision Record template/contract before Gate evaluation.

items.control: A production operation can be reconstructed from one evidence package/manifest.
items.remaining_action: Gate verifies all required artifact references can be represented; actual records are populated during production.

items.control: Failure/undetermined paths stop advancement rather than being treated as success.
No architecture-critical unresolved implementation gap remains before first production identity allocation.
basis: PRG-07, PRG-08, PRG-09, PRG-11, PRG-12, PRG-13 require concrete contracts
items.remaining_action: Complete the six pre-gate artifacts, then evaluate the formal Gate.
